description:
**Phase E — Compaction orchestration. Deps: E5b.**

Add `/compact [instructions]` to `OctoPi.Coder.Extensions.Commands`. Optional free-text `instructions` are passed as `custom_instructions` and threaded into `generate_summary/N` (template already supports it via `UPDATE_SUMMARIZATION_PROMPT`).

Tests: command parser test + integration test that invocation triggers `Session.compact/2`.
